examples.text: Afirmaréis seguros que es la capital de España / Pero al llegar agosto, ¡vaya, vaya! / Aquí no hay playa
examples.ref: 1989, “Aquí no hay playa”, performed by The Refrescos:
examples.english: You will surely affirm that it is the capital of Spain / But when August arrives, wow, wow! / There is no beach here
examples.translation: You will surely affirm that it is the capital of Spain / But when August arrives, wow, wow! / There is no beach here
